purpose: Authorize exactly one isolated evidence directory so a single final live sequence-4 smoke can prove the hardened bridge termination semantics end to end: one evidence-only marker, one deterministic verification of it, one normal verification-layer pass, then PASS -> FINAL RESPONSE -> STOP. This package authorizes the task; it performs nothing itself.

smoke_role.why: The hardened bridge must be shown once, live, to consume a task, execute it, verify it once and terminate cleanly.
smoke_role.must_be_safe: Its entire write surface is one isolated evidence directory, so it cannot reach the control plane by construction.

read_first.why: the orchestration layer's own entry description, confirming this task touches no orchestration code
how the orchestration layer integrates, confirming the smoke consumes existing seams only

boundary_notes.resolution: allowed_paths and forbidden_paths are project-relative to the Contract Guard source_root; an entry is a directory prefix or an exact file.
boundary_notes.single_allowed_directory: Exactly one directory is allowed. No parent directory above it is allow-listed, so the authorization cannot widen into the control plane.
boundary_notes.no_overlap: No allowed path is equal to, inside, or a parent of any forbidden path; the compiler reports zero E_PATH_CONFLICT.
boundary_notes.unlisted_is_blocked: Any path inside the project root matching neither list stays BLOCKED (UNCLASSIFIED_FAIL_CLOSED).
boundary_notes.control_plane_unreachable: bridge/, evaluation_adapter/, HERMES-LOCK.json, specification/ and .hermes.md are all forbidden, so this smoke cannot modify the control plane even if it tried.

termination_semantics.autofinalizer: POST-SESSION only; never invoked, inspected, waited for or verified inside the session
termination_semantics.on_pass: no further tool call, no search, no read, no audit, no repeated verification, no exploratory check; Phase C report in the FINAL ASSISTANT RESPONSE from evidence already collected; compact final result; STOP immediately
termination_semantics.on_fail: repair only the failed contract item; do not re-run already-passed work unless the repair invalidated it

contract_notes.single_live_use: the single final live sequence-4 smoke
